title: Law of large numbers for stochastic multiscale spatial gene networks
summary: We study a stochastic multiscale spatial gene network. These naturally arise in molecular biology. In our model, the reactants are subject to on-site reactions on both scales and diffusion on the continuous scale only, although diffusion on both scales could easily be handled. We obtain, under a light condition on the scales between the total population size and the mesh discretisation, the convergence of the stochastic system to a deterministic system consisting of a PDE coupled to a ODE. This is in contrast with the well-stirred case where jumps remain at the limit. In order to prove this…
